intro.all: All the world's news in one place: Journal 999 picks up the headlines of dozens of leading newspapers in English, French, Arabic and Spanish every day, and sends you to the original article.
intro.world: The World section gathers major international events: diplomacy, conflicts, elections, climate and big political decisions, as seen by newspapers on several continents. Comparing the same day's headlines helps you step back.
intro.maghreb: Tunisia, Algeria, Morocco: this section follows political, economic and social news from the Maghreb through local French- and Arabic-language press, for a reading close to the ground.
intro.arab: The Arab world through its own media and the international press: Middle East, Gulf, Levant and North Africa, with sources in Arabic, English and French.
intro.business: Markets, companies, energy, jobs and global trade: economic headlines from the leading financial dailies, to follow what moves the real economy.
intro.tech: Artificial intelligence, software, cybersecurity, innovation: the best technology sources in one place for a sector that changes every week.
intro.sport: Football, tennis, basketball, international competitions: results and top sports headlines from the world's main newspapers, continuously.
intro.science: Space, health, climate, discoveries: science and environment stories worth following, from leading international press.

about.title: About Journal 999
about.p1: Journal 999 is a digital newsstand: it displays headlines and short excerpts published by newspapers worldwide through their public RSS feeds, and always links to the publisher's site for the full article. No article is copied or republished.
about.p2: What we add: sorting by section and region, reading in four languages with full right-to-left Arabic support, headline de-duplication, reader mode, audio playback, bookmarks and — for Pro subscribers — AI summaries.
about.p3: All content remains the property of its respective publishers. If you are a publisher and want your feed removed, write to us.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.p1: We collect the bare minimum. Your preferences (theme, language, free-edition bookmarks) are stored locally in your browser.
privacy.p2: The free edition shows Google AdSense ads. Google and its partners may use cookies to serve ads; you choose between personalized or non-personalized ads in the banner. More information: policies.google.com/technologies/ads.
privacy.p3: The Pro edition uses Google sign-in (name, email, photo) only to identify your account. Payments are processed by Dodo Payments: we never see or store your card details.
privacy.p4: To exercise your rights of access, correction or deletion, write to the contact address.

footer.note: Journal 999 aggregates public headlines. All content belongs to its publishers.
